message.reasoning_content:
Now I actually see p1-p4 images.

p1: good. Clean, readable hierarchy. Pass.
p2: good; minor redundant sub-label "前部核验记录" under 9个/284份 — small, low contrast; acceptable improvement but not blocking. Also 03 card has empty lower area — balanced. Pass with minor note.
p3: Issues: 01 四个环节 four boxes have big empty lower area, and a stray "● 中部核验记录" tag sits at bottom-left inside/under card 01 (misplaced, duplicated with section 02 label). Also cards 02/03/04 empty. This looks unpolished/confusing. Improvement.
p4: good. Note "末部" annotation fine. Big 42.7 with % smaller. Pass.

p5: seen earlier — dense but readable; heavy duplication with p4 (content issue).
p6: subtitle text second line clipped by cards ("区分呈现，不做补写。" appears cut at bottom by card top). Let me look at the p6 image again: the description line "同一份资料内，三类状态的记录程度并不相同：已完成项有明确条目与数值，计划项与未确定项在资料中没有对应记载，本页按原样区分呈现，不做补写。" — the second line appears cut off horizontally by the card row starting. In the screenshot, the text at y≈237 shows only the top half of characters, cards start at y≈240. Yes — clipped. That's a blocker visual issue.

Also p6: 已完成 card's bottom data lines sit right at card bottom edge (slightly touching). Minor.

Now record visual assessment for all 6 pages with evidence ids: bf127bbc... (p1-p4) and da4e9760... (p5, p6).

Issues:
- blocker p6: TEXT_CLIPPED — 说明段第二行被下方三栏卡片裁切，"本页按原样区分呈现，不做补写"不可完整阅读。
- improvement p3: 环节卡片下方大片空白 + 卡片01底部游离的"中部核验记录"标签，与02节标题重复，层级含混。
- improvement p2: 数字副标重复"前部核验记录"，与卡片标题重复。

Then content assessment: separate call. Content issue: p5 重复 p4 三段数据（页内还重复一次 9/284 等）。That's improvement.

Then revisions: p6 (fix clip), p3 (fix stray label + empty space), p5 (dedup). Three pages reworked, each ≤2 reworks.

Let me record visual first.
